scope: PostgreSQL persistence and lease boundaries; the supplied WorkerQueue save/enqueue/cancel excerpts; and Operations publicWorkView/worker get/list serialization. Not the full filesystem facade, API authorization, workspace quota admission, mission orchestration or whole V3 candidate.
repairs: Existing recovery_required survives cancellation in both local and PostgreSQL queues; queued/safe cancellation retains its terminal behavior.

Generic saveWork validates parent mission and step inside INSERT SELECT, inherits parent workspace, rejects foreign-instance/workspace creation and rejects same-id updates from another mission, step or kind.

Snapshot save is limited to never-started preflight work; it cannot overwrite claimed, expired, uncertain or retried work, or forge already-executed work. Dedicated lease/recovery transitions remain available.
Operations worker list/get always strips existing lease tokens, including unscoped clients. Explicit claim still issues its own credential and legitimate owned completion still works.

adjudication.summary: No unresolved in-scope contract defects. PostgreSQL snapshot fencing, parent/identity immutability, owned-lease clock fencing, completion+evidence+usage transaction, cancellation uncertainty, token redaction on Operations get/list, bounded leases, and policy-disabled optional execution match the persistence-lease-read-closure acceptance set.
factualBasis: saveWork rejects leased/completed/recovery payloads and non-zero attempts or __leaseToken, and the upsert WHERE requires existing status='queued', attempts=0, null lease, and unchanged mission/step/kind/instance/workspace.

claim/heartbeat/complete/fail/recover/cancel use owner+payload token and clock_timestamp expiry; completeWorkWithEvidence inserts evidence, AccountingStore.record on the same client, and completion in one transaction.

cancelWork keeps recovery_required for recovery_required or non-replay-safe leased work; retryWork does not reset attempts; claim stores __leasedAt and heartbeat does not overwrite it; assertLeaseDuration caps leases at 900000ms.

operations publicWorkView strips lease.token and payload.__leaseToken on get/list; claim returns the worker credential; workRow still reads __leaseToken for owned completion. READ-LEASE-01 and SAVE-LEASE/PARENT tests plus packet test evidence (52 PG tests pass) support this.
optionalExecutionRelease reports enabled:false / policy-disabled for hosted and sandbox.
remainingUncertainty: File-backed queue facade, API authorization beyond the labelled operations/workers excerpts, migrations, and full V3 launch are out of scope.
Workspace quota coverage, admission races, and node_jobs vs work_items are explicitly unresolved and not certified.
The packet does not include a passing full 600-test main gate; this step cannot authorize a whole-candidate commit.
operations.ts and workers.ts were only supporting excerpts, not whole-file inspection.
